topic: Read any miner's spec in three steps
hook: Read any mining spec in three steps.

scenes.narration: First, find the hashrate in terahash per second. One terahash per second is one trillion hashes every second.
Second, find the efficiency in watts per terahash. Lower is more efficient.
Third, find the running cost. Electricity is typically a miner's largest ongoing cost.

cta: Which spec confuses you? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: How to Read a Mining Spec in 3 Steps
description_body: Hashrate, efficiency and running cost: the three numbers on any mining spec.
